title: Crypt Killer
overview: Lock and load your shotgun 'cos here's the motliest group of mythical monsters an adventurer could face. Delve deep into caverns and crypts in search of the Eyes of Guidance that'll open the Doors of Fate. But keep an eye open for the guardians of these deep underground treasure troves or they'll rip you to shreds. To help you on your way, you'll find weapons and ammo dropped by previous visitors - be careful how you use 'em. For one or two players.
